/.title: Forkward — Pantry Lens recipes, food swaps & Reflect AI
/.description: Forkward is a free, private cooking companion: turn kitchen photos into three Australian or Filipino recipe cards with Pantry Lens, explore food swaps, and try Reflect AI. Not medical advice.

/pantry.title: Pantry Lens — recipes from your fridge & pantry photos | Forkward
/pantry.description: Upload up to four fridge, freezer, pantry, cupboard or bench photos, confirm the ingredients, and get three practical Australian, Filipino or fusion recipe cards. Photos are not saved.

/reflect.title: Reflect AI — conceptual before/after visual studies | Forkward
/reflect.description: Reflect AI is a standalone studio for conceptual before/after visual studies from a mirror photo and routine sliders. Educational visualisation only — not a medical prediction.

/swaps.title: Food & drink swaps — how much if I swapped X for Y? | Forkward
/swaps.description: Compare everyday swaps for beer, potatoes, chips, rice and pasta with educational estimates and clear alcohol disclaimers. Not medical advice.

/privacy.title: Privacy — how Forkward handles your photos | Forkward
/privacy.description: Forkward keeps photos in-session only: not uploaded to a Forkward server, never written to localStorage. Optional meal prefs stay on your device and can be forgotten anytime.
